newsitem.title: USA: Sumner Redstone lifts WMS stake to 28.59 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sumner Redstone lifts WMS stake to 28.59 pct.

text.p: Massachusetts investor Sumner Redstone said on Tuesday he raised his stake in WMS Industries Inc to 28.59 percent or 6,917,700 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Redstone, who is chairman of Viacom Inc, said he and his company, National Amusements Inc, bought 988,600 additional shares of WMS between January 2 and 7 at prices ranging from $19.75 to $21.50 a share.

According to the filing, Redstone and National Amusements have federal regulatory approval to buy shares "that may exceed 25 percent but not equal or exceed 50 percent" of WMS' outstanding common stock.
WMS is a Chicago-based manufacturer of coin-operated and home video games, pinball and novelty games and video lottery terminals and other gaming devices.
